name: met-viewer
$comment-hdf5: hdf5 is requested with default-features off to drop `szip`, whose only
purpose here is to pull in libaec. libaec is fetched from gitlab.dkrz.de,
which rate-limits archive downloads (HTTP 429) hard enough to fail CI on
both platforms; a newer vcpkg does not help, since the 1.1.7 port only
renames the project path and stays on the same host. Nothing else wants
libaec: netcdf-c asks for exactly hdf5[hl,zlib], eccodes[aec] is opt-in
and we do not request it, and we never call HDF5 directly.
The cost is that szip/AEC-compressed HDF5 and NetCDF-4 cannot be read,
which matches what the app already did (eccodes[aec] was never enabled,
so AEC-packed GRIB2 was already unsupported) and ERA5/NOAA NetCDF use
deflate. Re-enabling szip is reverting this entry to a bare "hdf5".
$comment-windeployqt: qtbase's `windeployqt` feature is not on by default, so the tool was
simply absent and the Windows install had nothing to bundle the Qt DLLs
with. The port installs it at tools/Qt6/bin/windeployqt.exe, which is
where cmake/Packaging.cmake looks. Requested only on windows: the
feature declares "supports": "windows" and would not resolve elsewhere.
